$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter family — PageStructure. Major version 1. Materialized at the Structural Mapping gate (issue #14 G2; ADR-005-013). The resolved intermediate artifact: editorial sections with stable hashed ids, ordered elements, content references, responsive composition and per-element resolution status. Explicitly NOT raw cms_page.content or any platform serialization — platform rendering is later gated adapter work. True site chrome is absent from sections by construction; exclusions live in the review report with reasons.
title: Design Engineering Toolkit — PageStructure (structural plan)

source.description: Design-source revision the structure was built from; must equal the pinned NodeIR's source revision.

nodeIrContentHash.description: STABLE content hash of the exact NodeIR payload this structure was derived from: SHA-256 over canonical JSON with ALL observation timestamps removed — re-extraction of the same source revision reproduces it (full input pinning).

registryRevisionId.description: Pinned capability registry revision used for target resolution, when one was supplied. Consumers reject mismatches (EVIDENCE_MISSING).

bindingMapContentHash.description: STABLE content hash of the binding map used (observation timestamps removed), when one was supplied.

inputs.description: Full input pinning. Registry/binding pins are present iff those inputs were supplied to the extraction.

sections.description: Editorial sections only, in page order. Site chrome, hidden nodes, merged decorations and unresolved references never appear here — their exclusion reasons live in the source-review report.

diagnostics.description: Structure-level findings in canonical diagnostic order.

sectionId.description: Stable identity: 's-' + first 12 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over sourceId, the section's designLocator and order joined by U+241F.

order.description: Document position of the section in the plan; unique. Sections are sorted by (order, sectionId).

role.description: Optional semantic role; open vocabulary. Name prefixes are hints only.

layout.description: Same layout primitive shape as NodeIR nodes, preserved verbatim.

elements.description: Document order. Every element also appears in the pinned NodeIR; nodes that are hidden, merged decoration, chrome, or unresolved references do not appear here.

sourceEvidence.description: design:// locator(s) of the section's source node.

elementId.description: Reuses the NodeIR node id — one identity per source node across artifacts.

sourceComponentId.description: G2 binding vocabulary: the NodeIR node id of the referenced kind-'component' definition. Absent for structural nodes without component identity. Same grammar as binding-map sourceComponentId.

variantAssignment.description: Observed variant/property assignment of the instance (open string map), consumed by binding variantConditions matching.

bindingId.description: Present iff a binding resolved this element against the pinned registry + binding map.

target.description: Present iff proven by a validated binding against the pinned registry; never guessed from names.

contentType.description: Closed enum (component slots are structural elements, not slot values).

aliasRef.description: Project-level content alias when the value is planned as a reference rather than a literal source locator.

fixtureRef.description: Explicit mock marker: value is MOCK_CONTENT for isolated QA only, never production content.

effect.description: Declared effect within the scope (open vocabulary).

responsiveComposition.description: Sorted by scope. Carried only from declared evidence; never inferred.

childrenElementIds.description: Direct element children in document order (nesting edges among mapped elements only).

status.description: Closed family enum. 'unmapped' with zero diagnostics is the honest pending state for components with no proven target (custom-required / data-provider-pending) — extraction reports it, later gated stages decide blocking.

diagnostics.description: Element-scoped findings in canonical diagnostic order.
